measurements: feed-forward compression where defined (H1/H3/H4/H5/H6; never H0)
synthetic depth-20 root update (not a direct deposit)
complete direct deposit: frozen H0 baseline only; non-H0 NOT_EVALUATED
resultPolicy: Measured candidate-named values and explicit NOT_EVALUATED fields are retained in results.json. Raw Forge gas-report stdout/stderr is retained verbatim in forge-gas-report.txt; its inherited H0 compression and fullStorageDeposit labels are superseded by results.json.
measurementMethod: gasleft delta around a low-level external call to a freshly deployed target; ABI encoding precedes measurement and return-data copying is included
syntheticHarnessLimitation: ResearchTree measures 20 hashes plus a dynamic uint256[] root update. It omits real deposit/state work and contradicts the protocol's two-slot digest representation, so it cannot satisfy the complete direct-deposit gate.

gateSemantics.fiveXNodeReduction: Compare node permutation counts from native/operation-counts.json; do not compare node gas.
gateSemantics.completeDirectDeposit: Compare complete protocol direct-deposit gas only; syntheticDepth20RootUpdateGas is excluded.
